provision.quote: Challenge is to show cause notice dated 26/06/2025 issued by respondent no.4, under Section 74 of The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (for short “CGST Act”).

financial_years.quote: The notice dated 27/06/2025 pertains to financial years 2018-19 to 2020-21 saying that the petitioner has, during this period, suppressed taxable value, and thereby made short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax.

defects_argued.quote: In the present case, since this Court has, subsequent to decision of the Delhi High Court, taken a different view, the authorities below will be bound by the subsequent judgments.

outcome.quote: With the above liberty, and for the reasons set out in Milroc Good Earth Developers (supra) and Rite Water Solutions (India) Ltd. (supra), the petition is partly allowed.
